text: Abel Roos. I came over on the ferry for the Cup. I've never played anybody I didn't already know.
You don't play at all? Then no, sorry. Wren, at the bar down the steps, teaches. Come back after.
Would you... sorry. Would you want a game? Nothing in here counts. That's the appeal.

exit.intro: He puts the bowls out the wrong way round, swaps them, and swaps them back.

text: Right. I'll be here. Forty minutes left on this machine and nowhere to be.
You beat me. That's fine. That's what I came for, people who'd beat me.
Sorry. That came out as though I'd planned it.
I won. I don't know what to do with my face.
Another? I want to know if that was me, or you having a bad one.
